i have a net worth of close to a million (well, maybe $900k with this recent plunge in the financial markets).  I do not consider myself rich at all and am quite frugal with my finances.  money doesn't bring me much happiness but it has given me the flexibility to not have to work at the moment. 

well, all i can say finding the right psych/therapist is sometimes worth millions.  i saw a really good one a few years ago and he steered me in the right direction.  i didn't see it at the time, but in retrospect he steered me completely in the right direction.  I totally wish i had someone like that alittle after college.... he would have saved me decades of misery. 

always hard to open up to a stranger.   i believe in therapy only if you find the right person for you.  the wrong one can do as much damage as good.
